description:
From the 2026-07-12 tuning review, findings R3 (partial), N1, N2, N3
(evidence pinned to commit acfb8992). Small, independent, decision-free fixes:

1. Dry-run tuning preview is silently empty: _extract_ddl_preview
   (benchbox/core/dryrun.py:1087) does exact-key lookup
   table_tunings.get(table_name) with lowercase benchmark names vs uppercase
   template keys (LINEITEM) - verified: tuned duckdb/tpch dry-run rendered 0
   tuning clauses. Normalize case like profile_validation.extract_template_columns
   already does (.upper()).
2. Dry-run shows "Databricks Clustering Strategy: z_order" under Platform
   Optimizations for non-Databricks runs (observed on duckdb) - suppress
   platform-foreign default fields.
3. --dry-run takes a required OUTPUT_DIR string and swallows a following flag:
   `--dry-run --non-interactive` created a directory literally named
   "--non-interactive" (run.py:2597-2602). Reject values starting with '-'.
4. A local file/dir named "tuned" shadows the tuned keyword because path
   existence is checked before keywords (tuning_resolver.py:200-207). Check
   keywords first.
5. Invalid-value error hint says "--tuning list", itself an invalid value
   (tuning_resolver.py:316,326); the real command is `benchbox tuning list`.

anti_patterns.dont: rewrite the preview to use adapter mixins here
anti_patterns.why: renderer unification is gated on ADR-3

preserves.behavior: Dry-run remains non-executing and side-effect free apart from its output dir
Explicit file paths (including relative) keep working for --tuning

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m benchbox.cli.main run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --tuning tuned --dry-run /tmp/dr-check --non-interactive 2>&1 | grep -c 'ORDER BY'
verifications.description: Tuned duckdb dry-run now shows tuning clauses

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m benchbox.cli.main run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --dry-run --non-interactive 2>&1 | tail -3
verifications.expected: Clear error about missing OUTPUT_DIR, no directory named '--non-interactive' created

work_units.notes:
Also fixed two co-requisite bugs uncovered while making this fix land
end-to-end (both in benchbox/core/dryrun.py, same scope):
- _extract_ddl_preview gated on `hasattr(benchmark, "get_tables")`, a
  method no benchmark class implements (only platform adapters do);
  switched to `benchmark.get_schema()` (the method _generate_external_
  schema_sql already uses for the same purpose).
- _build_table_ddl_entry referenced TuningClauses.distribution_key /
  distribution_style, fields that don't exist on the dataclass (it has
  distribute_by instead), so it raised AttributeError as soon as the
  lookup fix let it actually run. Now delegates to
  TuningClauses.get_inline_clauses() (already used by
  generate_create_table_ddl) instead of re-deriving clause text.
Without both fixes the case-insensitive lookup could never be observed
to work: the DDL preview was empty for every platform, always, before
table_tunings was even consulted.
work_units.summary: Case-normalize table-key lookup in _extract_ddl_preview (+ regression test using the shipped duckdb tpch template)

work_units.notes:
_display_platform_optimizations (benchbox/cli/dryrun.py) is out of
scope_limit, so the fix is at the data source instead: threaded
platform through DryRunExecutor._extract_tuning_config ->
_extract_unified_tuning (benchbox/core/dryrun.py) and gated
databricks_clustering_strategy on platform == "databricks" via a
small field->platform map, so the display code (which just renders
whatever is in the dict) no longer sees it for other platforms.
work_units.summary: Suppress platform-foreign optimization rows in dry-run display; only show fields relevant to the target platform
Reject option-like values for --dry-run OUTPUT_DIR (leading '-') with a clear error
Resolver: check keywords (tuned/notuning/auto) before path existence; fix the '--tuning list' hint to 'benchbox tuning list'
